ov: The house sparrow is a small, stocky bird that lives alongside people in towns and farms. Native to Europe, the Mediterranean and much of Asia, it was taken around the world and is now the most widely distributed wild bird.
rg: Native to Europe, the Mediterranean and much of Asia; introduced to parts of Australasia, Africa and the Americas.
df: Seeds of grains and weeds, plus food from bird feeders.
fx: It avoids large forests, grasslands and deserts far from people.
notes: The existing fact is confirmed: it followed humans and is now the most widely distributed wild bird.
